stadiums.name: Estadio Azteca
stadiums.content:
Estadio AztecaMexico City Stadium

This historic stadium will open the FIFA World Cup 2026 and host five tournament matches, including two Mexico group games and two knockout fixtures.

  • 11 June 2026: Mexico v South Africa, Group A
  • 17 June 2026: Uzbekistan v Colombia, Group K
  • 24 June 2026: Czechia v Mexico, Group A
  • 30 June 2026: Match 79, Round of 32
  • 5 July 2026: Match 92, Round of 16

stadiums.name: Estadio Akron
stadiums.content:
Estadio AkronEstadio Guadalajara

Guadalajara will host four group-stage fixtures. The biggest local highlight is Mexico v Korea Republic on 18 June.

  • 11 June 2026: Korea Republic v Czechia, Group A
  • 18 June 2026: Mexico v Korea Republic, Group A
  • 23 June 2026: Colombia v Congo DR, Group K
  • 26 June 2026: Uruguay v Spain, Group H

stadiums.name: Estadio BBVA
stadiums.content:
Estadio BBVAEstadio Monterrey

Monterrey will host three group-stage matches and one Round of 32 knockout match, making it an important northern Mexico stop for travelling fans.

  • 14 June 2026: Sweden v Tunisia, Group F
  • 20 June 2026: Tunisia v Japan, Group F
  • 24 June 2026: South Africa v Korea Republic, Group A
  • 29 June 2026: Match 75, Round of 32
